title: Depth bound for mapped circuits
statement: Let $n$ and $m$ be natural numbers, let $f$ map circuits on $n$ variables to circuits on $n$ variables, and let $cs$ be a list of such circuits. If every $c\in cs$ satisfies $\mathrm{depth}(f(c))\le m$, then the maximum depth among the circuits $f(c)$ for $c\in cs$ is at most $m$, with the maximum defined to be $0$ for an empty list.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps circuits on $n$ variables to circuits on $n$ variables
$cs$ is a list of circuits on $n$ variables
